title: Booster
description: A crimped foil booster pack of six album cards built from real covers. Tear the strip across the top, pull the stack out, and swipe through commons and uncommons to the rare holo waiting at the back.
intent: The trading-card pack ritual finished to the edge: metallic foil that tears along your drag and peels away, a stack that slides cleanly out of the mouth, and a rarity reveal that pays off at the last card.
